A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1541 hostap batch 9 (wpa_supplicant/config.c .. wpa_supplicant/ibss_rsn.c). Same standard as batches 1-8 (see correction-api00c-644-hostap-b1-task1541), under ADR-0011 as of aurora-lint d9cb04d0. A function nothing outside the corpus can call, whose every call site provably tests the value, has a validated parameter. Every link of an argument's provenance chain must end in a real proof: an explicit NULL test, a language guarantee, an address-of or local/static array, or a literal. A prior dereference of the pointer, or of an array member's base, is not a proof.

RESULT: 137 rows. 116 TP stand (reason restated to the TP basis; source unchanged) and 21 are corrected TP -> FP here, a flip rate of 15.3%. A fresh-context refuter, applying the d9cb04d0 rule, reviewed all 23 proposed flips. It upheld 21 and rejected 2 whose only support was a dereference: gas_query.c:536 (mgmt->da, with mgmt the driver-event frame and never tested) and ctrl_iface.c:14983 (the named-pipe site's dst reaches it through a Win32 completion routine with no test). Upheld flips include the dbus getter/setter iter rows (all four ->getter/->setter invocations, dbus_new_helpers.c:50/181/632/218, pass &local) and hs20_supplicant.c:69/93, where the test lives in a callee whose return the caller tests (wpabuf_resize, is_hs20_network) and holds on every return path.
